risk_summary: The excerpt is relatively well quantified, but relies on standard forward-looking disclaimers and adjusted results that exclude significant impairment and restructuring-related costs. Key risks include declining Information Security and Print Finishing revenue, legacy quality issues, customer attrition, segment losses, and dependence on successful cost and ERP initiatives. Sporting Goods performance is stronger, but management’s outlook remains contingent on additional sales growth and execution.
